> Sure. But can you bring the second one into play and use his special to
> remove him even if you have only titled vampires and as long as the
> first one is already in play?

I think Orpheus was right in his thinking. The converts are there to
mess up another player by changing the sect of a mind raped vampire
from Sabbat, Camarilla, or Laibon to independent (as well as cycle to
your next crypt card). Just as an example, a laibon could be totally
screwed by making orun or aye useless for that vampire, even worse
Terra Incognita would be useless completely. (Maybe he was expecting a
heavy Laibon environment?) It would be interesting to hear if this is
what Erol was thinking.

Messages.Author: eRol
Messages.Body:


Yeah, one thing is to make mind raped minions to anarchs for faster
crypt cycling, but I never had teh opprtunity to use it that way.
There are actually four other useful things you can do with the AC:

1. Blocker - saved Arikas live once or twice
2. Defense against Anrach Revolts
3. Fast acting minion - gave me the advantage of having the Heart of
Cheating in round 2
4. Target for diablerie - its not difficult to get the AC in torpor,
so Mind Rape somebody and let him diablerize the AC, burn him, Orlando
Oriundus is my favorite target :)

Messages.Author: eRol
Messages.Body:


The version I took with me, had 90 cards, +3 Zillahs Valley, +2
Entrancement, +3 Obedience and some other stuff I cant remember right
now. My experience with the overall metagame I saw the days before,
helped me with the decision to reduce the decksize, and actually that
helped a lot. I never regretted it, it always seemed that I had the
right cards in my hand. Just like in round 2 against Martin Major and
his Salubri/!Ventrue Deck, without having the 5 Deflections in my
hand, I wouldnt stood a chance against his bleed onslaught. There was
not much dedicated combat or allies deck around, so the Entrancement
and the Obedience could go. I think I increased stealth a little bit.
To remove the Zillahs was a hard choice, lucky me I drew the Info
Highway always early in the game, except for the Final. But as big
Vampires seem to be the latest hype, with cards like Monastery of
Shadows and Enkil Cog, I wasnt afraid of having a weenie deck behind
me.
